snapshot.title: Client Notification Authorization — CP&L and CVAC

fields.subject: FW: Client Notification for CP&L and CVAC
fields.note:
I have reviewed the evidence. The threat actor accessed and read CP&L and CVAC data during the unauthorized session on GCS-02 (08:42–08:57). The data was not only encrypted but also exposed. The verification plan is in place. The Group will notify CP&L and CVAC per HUOG-ISP Section 7.5.

I authorize the Communications Lead (PIO) to send the client notification letter. The letter must state facts only: that data was read, that recovery is underway, and that D-3 will be delayed by 10 days. No speculation.

The Group does not pay the ransom. Decision recorded.
fields.signature:
Marguerite Ostrowski
General Manager
Harwick UAS Operations Group
